relationships.evidence_quote: IL-10 inhibited the production of IL-1α, IL-1β, and TNF-α and IL-8 and macrophage inflammatory protein-α from LPS-activated human monocytes and other chemokines [45].

relationships.subject: VEGF
relationships.evidence_quote: Studies showed that exogenous VEGF stimulates chondrocytes to produce increased levels of pro-inflammatory factors IL-1β, IL-6, and TNF-α [59].

key_findings: In 36 OA patients, 21-day rehabilitation after hip/knee replacement increased serum VEGF, IL-6, IL-10, IL-1RA and several chemokines and decreased FGF basic, with TNF-α unchanged.
Unchanged TNF-α and increased IL-6 were interpreted as stable, controlled inflammation with anti-inflammatory IL-6 effect.
